name: Warna

attributes.attribute: honored on the Isles of Scilly
received offerings at her sacred well for wreckage wealth

sources: Straffon, Cheryl. The Earth Goddess: Celtic and Pagan Legacy of the Landscape. London: Blandford, 1997, 83.
Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Warna is a Cornish heroine or goddess. She guards shipwrecked mariners and is venerated on the Scilly Islands near Cornwall. Some accounts treat her as the ancient deity of that district or of its seas. A local habit gave offerings at her sacred well, hoping to draw the wealth of wrecked ships ashore.

okr.objective: Present Warna as a Cornish patron figure of shipwrecked sailors.
key_results: Warna guards shipwrecked mariners on the Isles of Scilly.
She may have been the goddess of the region or its waters.
Offerings at her sacred well sought the wealth of wrecked ships.
